heroHeadline: Trump Weighs Direct US Participation in Saudi Strikes on Houthis After Riyadh Airport Attack
heroSubtitle: Following the deadly Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, Trump is evaluating whether to join Saudi Arabia's retaliatory strikes on Houthis, potentially marking a significant escalation of US military involvement in the Yemen theater.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, The Hindu, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record.
